correctness.rationale: The counterexample is exact. Disease-free spatially constant data keep u,L,I,R equal to zero up to the switch, while H remains strictly positive by the logistic equation. The source convention changes the Heaviside factor to one for t>t_s, so the right derivative of R at the boundary is -r_s H(t_s)<0 and R immediately becomes negative. A fresh numerical replay using the source values gives H(95)=5.5239951658751245 and right derivative -0.5689715020851378. The source's explicit update has the identical sign defect, and summing the printed component equations reproduces the doubled senescence loss in its total-density equation.
